key_insight: A wall-resolved iLES database can reproduce bypass transition physics in flat-plate boundary layers more faithfully than legacy benchmarks and exposes major weaknesses in standard RANS transition models.
engineering_relevance: This dataset provides a high-fidelity reference for improving transition prediction in aerodynamic and turbomachinery design, especially for calibration of physics-informed and machine-learning closures.
method: High-order compressible Navier-Stokes solver with implicit LES
Multiple freestream turbulence levels with zero and varying pressure gradients
evidence_signal: The simulations show satisfactory agreement with experimental skin friction, mean velocity, and fluctuation profiles, while SA-BCM and k-ω-γ models systematically mispredict transition onset and length.
watch_item: The database is highly resolved and configuration-specific, so transferring conclusions to other geometries or less-resolved CFD setups may require additional validation.
paper_title: A high-fidelity numerical database for free-stream transition
